approve(address,address,uint256).details: Allows to give permission for onBehalf function execution, allowing 3rd party to perform actions such as borrowOnBehalf and withdrawOnBehalf with amount limit

borrowExactAmount(uint256,address,uint25.details: Allows to borrow ERC20 funds Requires user to have collateral.

borrowExactAmountETH(uint256,uint256).details: Allows to borrow ETH funds Requires user to have collateral.

borrowOnBehalfExactAmount(uint256,addres.details: Allows to borrow ERC20 funds on behalf of _nftId owner, if approved.

calculateBorrowShares(address,uint256,bo.details: Helper function to convert {_amount} of a certain pool with {_poolToken} into borrow shares. Includes devison by zero and share security checks. Needs latest pseudo amount for accurate result.

calculateLendingShares(address,uint256,b.details: Helper function to convert {_amount} of a certain pool with {_poolToken} into lending shares. Includes devison by zero and share security checks. Needs latest pseudo amount for accurate result.

cashoutAmount(address,uint256).details: Helper function to convert {_shares} of a certain pool with {_poolToken} into lending token. Includes devison by zero and share security checks. Needs latest pseudo amount for accurate result.

claimOwnership().details: Allows to claim master role. Must be called by proposer.

collateralizeDeposit(uint256,address).details: Enables _poolToken to be used as a collateral.

corePaybackFeeManager(address,uint256,ui.details: External wrapper for {_corePayback} logic callable by feeMananger.

depositExactAmount(uint256,address,uint2.details: Allows to supply _poolToken and user can decide if _poolToken should be collateralized.

depositExactAmountETH(uint256).details: Allows to supply funds using ETH. Without converting to WETH, use ETH directly.

depositExactAmountETHMint().details: Allows to supply funds using ETH. Without converting to WETH, use ETH directly, also mints position to avoid extra transaction.

depositExactAmountMint(address,uint256).details: Allows to supply _poolToken and user can decide if _poolToken should be collateralized, also mints position to avoid extra transaction.

firewall().details: 获取防火墙路由器地址

isUncollateralized(uint256,address).details: Internal helper function calculating returning if a {_poolToken} of a {_nftId} is uncollateralized.

liquidatePartiallyFromTokens(uint256,uin.details: Function to liquidate a postion which reaches a debt ratio greater than 100%. The liquidator can choose token to payback and receive. (Both can differ!). The amount is in shares of the payback token. The liquidator gets an incentive which is calculated inside the liquidation logic.

newBorrowRate(address).details: External wrapper for {_newBorrowRate} Only callable by powerFarms, feeManager and aaveHub.

paybackAmount(address,uint256).details: Helper function to convert {_shares} of a certain pool with {_poolToken} into borrow token. Includes devison by zero and share security checks. Needs latest pseudo amount for accurate result.

paybackExactAmount(uint256,address,uint2.details: Ability to payback ERC20 loans by providing exact payback amount.

paybackExactAmountETH(uint256).details: Ability to payback ETH loans by providing exact payback amount.

paybackExactShares(uint256,address,uint2.details: Ability to payback ERC20 loans by providing exact payback shares.

preparePool(address).details: External wrapper for {_preparePole} Only callable by powerFarms, feeManager and aaveHub.

proposeOwner(address).details: Allows to propose next master. Must be claimed by proposer.

renounceOwnership().details: Removes master role. No ability to be in control.

setFirewall(address).details: 公开设置防火墙地址（仅在未设置时可调用，支持动态更新）

setRegistrationIsolationPool(uint256,boo.details: Registers position _nftId for isolation pool functionality

skim(address).details: Transfers tokens to master which were sent to contract where pools exist

solelyDeposit(uint256,address,uint256).details: Allows to supply funds using ERC20 in solely mode, which does not earn APY, but keeps the funds private. Other users are restricted from borrowing these funds, owner can always withdraw even if all funds are borrowed.

solelyDepositETH(uint256).details: Allows to supply funds using ETH in solely mode, which does not earn APY, but keeps the funds private. Other users are restricted from borrowing these funds, owner can always withdraw even if all funds are borrowed.

solelyDepositETHMint().details: Allows to supply funds using ETH in solely mode, which does not earn APY, but keeps the funds private. Other users are restricted from borrowing these funds, owner can always withdraw even if all funds are borrowed. Also mints position to avoid extra transaction.

solelyDepositMint(address,uint256).details: Allows to supply funds using ERC20 in solely mode, which does not earn APY, but keeps the funds private. Other users are restricted from borrowing these funds, owner can always withdraw even if all funds are borrowed. Also mints position to avoid extra transaction.

solelyWithdraw(uint256,address,uint256).details: Allows to withdraw privately deposited ERC20 funds using input amount.

solelyWithdrawETH(uint256,uint256).details: Allows to withdraw privately deposited ETH funds using input amount.

solelyWithdrawOnBehalf(uint256,address,u.details: Allows to withdraw privately deposited ERC20 on behalf of owner. Requires approval by _nftId owner.

syncManually(address).details: Allows to sync pool manually so that the pool is up to date.

unCollateralizeDeposit(uint256,address).details: Disables _poolToken to be used as a collateral.

withdrawExactAmount(uint256,address,uint.details: Allows to withdraw publicly deposited ERC20 funds using exact amount.

withdrawExactAmountETH(uint256,uint256).details: Allows to withdraw publicly deposited ETH funds using exact amount.

withdrawExactShares(uint256,address,uint.details: Allows to withdraw ERC20 funds using shares as input value

withdrawExactSharesETH(uint256,uint256).details: Allows to withdraw publicly deposited ETH funds using exact shares.

withdrawOnBehalfExactAmount(uint256,addr.details: Allows to withdraw privately deposited ERC20 on behalf of owner. Requires approval by _nftId owner.

withdrawOnBehalfExactShares(uint256,addr.details: Withdraws ERC20 funds on behalf of _nftId owner, requires approval.
